title: Learning Futures September
summary: A look at standards, human-centred AI and designing better facilitated learning experiences.

speaker1.talkTitle: Why Do Standards Matter, and Why Might They Not?

speaker2.name: Rachelle Williams
speaker2.talkTitle: Beyond the Slides: Why the Best Facilitators Stop Presenting and Start Designing
speaker2.description: Six evidence-based principles for engaging, participant-led facilitation.

speaker3.name: Daryl Hedley
speaker3.talkTitle: Can learning be improved with the use of AI?
speaker3.description: Practical examples of human-centred AI in university learning and tutoring.
